chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning
A man who ordered his slave to kill a man, and he killed him—he said: “The master is to be killed for him.”

key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: is to be killed, meaning subject to legal retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a master orders his slave to kill someone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning intentional killing carried out by command. It states that when a master orders his slave to kill a man and the killing is carried out, the master is subject to retaliation (qisas) for the victim.
